why: I compared each check's PASS and FAIL conditions with the words of its expect line. Check 1 asks that the --shout output be the plain greeting in upper case. Partial upper case or a missing name fails, and that follows from the words. Check 2 compares the head output with the base output, which is what "unchanged" means. Check 3 needs docs/index.md to mention --shout and say what it does. That fits "documents", though it's a close call. Check 4 stands in for the live page, which can't be seen yet: the pages workflow must still publish docs/ and docs/index.md must list --shout. That proxy is needed to test "after merge, the published page lists"; the line "State in your report" only asks for a note. The stricter items (npm test, the flag after the name, the usage message with exit code 2, exact strings with newlines) all sit under "Advisory (not pass/fail conditions)".
